meta.description: Moving company FAQ from Better Life Moving: hourly billing, the 2-hour minimum, what's included, long distance flat rates, storage pricing and booking.

overview: How we bill, how booking works and what happens on moving day, answered in plain terms.

faq.q: How does hourly billing work for a local move?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added. Travel time covers the drive from our yard to your first address and from your last address back.
Yes, a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. That keeps small jobs, like moving a few pieces of furniture, affordable to book.

faq.q: What's included in the hourly rate?
faq.a: Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and truck costs (gas, mileage, tolls) are included in the hourly rate. You don't get a separate line for materials or fuel on a local move.

faq.q: How are long distance moves priced?
faq.a: Long distance moves are quoted at a flat rate. The quote is based on your move date, the size of your home and both addresses.
Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up. A manager gives you the figure with your quote.

faq.q: What do you need from me to give a quote?
faq.a: Your move date, the size of your home and both addresses. You can send them through the quote form or by phone.

faq.q: Do I have to pay a deposit to book?
faq.a: A manager explains the booking terms, including any deposit, when they go over your quote with you.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: As soon as you know your date. Late August and September are our busiest weeks in Boston because of the September 1 lease turnover.
Yes. The crew wraps furniture in blankets and shrink wrap before it leaves your home, and those materials are already in the hourly rate.

faq.q: What does the crew do on moving day?
faq.a: The crew wraps, loads, drives, unloads and places your furniture where you want it in the new home.

faq.q: My building needs an elevator booking. What should I do?
faq.a: Book the elevator for your move window and tell us the times when you request a quote, so the crew arrives inside it.

faq.q: How can I check that Better Life Moving is licensed?
faq.a: Look up USDOT 3866930 on the FMCSA's public carrier search. It shows our interstate operating authority and our MC number, 1414489.

faq.q: When was Better Life Moving founded?
faq.a: In 2022, by two professional movers in Brighton, Boston.

closing.body: Call us or send the quote form with your question in it, and a manager will answer it with your price.
